subject: Finalizing security review cadence and owners for Luminor Health
messages:
From: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminorhealth.com, security@luminorhealth.com
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security review: proposed agenda & attendees

Hi Grace / Aditya —

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. Security asked that we schedule a technical security review with Redwood next week to cover data flows, retention, and your SOC 2 controls. Proposed attendees on our side: Alex Roberts (Security), Jenna Park (Procurement), and our infra lead — I’ll confirm the specific engineer once I check calendars.

Can Redwood bring:
- Redwood security/compliance (high level SOC 2 + key controls)
- SE to answer architecture/network questions
- AE for commercial/contract questions (procurement will be on the call)

We’d like a 60–90 minute slot. Availability window: Tue 2/20 or Wed 2/21 between 10:00–16:00 PT.

I’ve attached a short list of topics our team wants covered and a sample questionnaire (SOC items). Let me know if you need anything else ahead of time.

Thanks,
Alex
--
Alex Roberts
Security Manager, Luminor Health
alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com
Attachment: luminor-security-requests.docx (docx)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review: proposed agenda & attendees

Thanks Alex — this is perfect context. Glad to coordinate.

Our proposed plan:
- Redwood attendees: Mina Haddad (Head of Security & Compliance), Karthik Iyer (SE, deployment architecture), myself (AE)
- Session length: I suggest 90 minutes so we can walk through architecture + controls + procurement questions without rushing. We can compress to 60 if procurement prefers.
- Pre-reads we’ll share: SOC2_summary.pdf (high level) and a brief agenda. Could you send the network/data-flow diagram for the environment we’ll be evaluating?

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2/20, 15:00–16:30
- Tue 2/20, 11:30–13:00
- Wed 2/21, 13:00–14:30

If any of those work, we’ll lock in and I’ll send a calendar invite + final agenda. Attaching v3 of the agenda with owners assigned (draft).

From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Feb 2028 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review: proposed agenda & attendees

Hi all — I can join and lead the compliance part. Thanks for the agenda draft, Grace — I made a couple of notes in the attached agenda (v3) and added a short SOC2 one-pager.

Pre-read requests (to make the session actionable):
- The network/data-flow diagram Alex mentioned (ideally with example request/response patterns)
- Any specific retention/PII classification bullets (if different environments have varying retention)

Owner suggestions for the call (draft):
- Compliance controls & attestations — Mina Haddad (Redwood)
- Deployment architecture & network/connectivity — Karthik Iyer (SE, Redwood)
- Procurement/contract Q&A — Aditya Rao (AE, Redwood)
- Customer environment questions — Alex Roberts / Luminor infra engineer

Times I can do (PT): Tue 2/20 11:30–13:00 or 15:00–16:30. If procurement / infra prefer shorter, we can aim for 60 minutes but I’ll keep some buffer.

Attaching: SOC2_summary.pdf, security-review-agenda-v3.docx

Thanks,
Mina
--
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
From: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminorhealth.com, jenna.park@luminorhealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 13:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review: proposed agenda & attendees

Grace / Mina —

Thanks, that schedule looks good. Quick note from procurement: they prefer a 60-minute session focused on the compliance highlights + commercial terms rather than a deep network deep-dive. Our infra lead is available for a shorter architecture block if we need it.

Would Tue 2/20 11:30–12:30 PT work? That would let procurement step out for a quick internal sync before the rest of their day. If Redwood needs more time, we can do 11:30–13:00 and procurement will stay for the first 60 minutes.

I’ll attach our network diagram in a follow-up — expect that later today.

On Thu, 16 Feb 2028 08:23, mina_haddad@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi all — I can join and lead the compliance part. Thanks for the agenda draft, Grace — I made a couple of notes in the attached agenda (v3) and added a short SOC2 one-pager.

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@luminorhealth.com
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review: proposed agenda & attendees

Alex / team —

Thanks for the procurement note. We can keep this tightly focused. To accommodate both procurement and a short architecture Q&A, can we do the following final plan:
- Tue 2/20 11:30–13:00 PT, with the understanding procurement will attend 11:30–12:30 and the infra Q&A will run 12:00–12:30 so procurement can step out if needed. This gives us a 30-minute dedicated architecture slot and 60 minutes for compliance/commercials.

If that sounds good, Grace will send the calendar invite + final agenda and we’ll lock the owners. Also linking the DocuSign starter for the terms we discussed separately: https://docusign.example.com/LUMINOR-terms

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Alex Roberts <alex.roberts@luminorhealth.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@luminorhealth.com, jenna.park@luminorhealth.com
Date: Tue, 20 Feb 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Security review: proposed agenda & attendees — CONFIRMED (calendar invite attached)

All — confirmed and thanks for the alignment. Final details below and I’ve attached the calendar invite and the final agenda.

Event: Redwood x Luminor Health — Security & Controls Review
When: Tue, 20 Feb 2028, 11:30–13:00 PT (we’ll keep procurement engaged 11:30–12:30)
Location: Zoom (link in calendar invite)
Owners and topics:
- Mina Haddad (Redwood) — SOC2, controls, attestation timeline
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood SE) — architecture, network connectivity, integration checklist (12:00–12:30 block)
- Aditya Rao (Redwood AE) — procurement & commercial Q&A (first 60 minutes)
- Alex Roberts / Luminor infra engineer — environment specifics & diagrams

Pre-reads: Received the network diagram from Alex — thanks. I attached SOC2_summary.pdf and security-review-agenda-v3.docx and the calendar invite cal-invite-luminor-redwood.ics.

If there are any last-minute changes please flag, otherwise we’ll join 5 minutes early to start on time. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Grace O’Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Attachment: cal-invite-luminor-redwood.ics (ics)
